metadata.title: CashALL Valuation Engine & Product Catalog Specification
metadata.minimumPayoutFloor: Max of ₹500 or 15% of Base Price
metadata.valuationFormula: Final Price = Max(Base Price - Sum(Base Price * DeductionPercent / 100), Max(500, Base Price * 0.15))
